title: Text: DET Bruce Tanner ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What are your reports on Reynaldo Lopez and Jack Flaherty?
Long-term. Thinking of trading Flaherty for Lopez in my keeper league
I will get back to you on that. How much time do you have?
Couple hours, no worries if not, know you're busy
What about Mikolas? Or Luke Weaver. Don't know Lopez that well but Mikolas could be a sleeper
I can draft Mikolas..any thoughts on Flaherty?

He's okay probably will need time to develop into a #4 type starter. He might surprise teams early because they don't know him but my guess is he probably settles in as a number 4 best case scenario from what I've seen would be a 3
Just tell your league and your commissioner that you're tired of their crap and that you want to draft Mikolas
Maybe I'll see you at Chili's or something. Shoot me a text if you go out anywhere
